entries.en: Tsubame appears quite pleased with your progress.
entries.fr: Tsubame vous regarde avec attention et semble avoir quelque chose à vous dire.
entries.ja: ツバメは、冒険者に感心をしているようだ。

entries.en: Tsubame is deeply impressed at the aptitude and affinity you have shown for the way of the shinobi, and she muses that your skills might one day rival her own. Now, the time has come to receive your next lesson. Enter the storehouse and speak with Oboro.
entries.fr: D'après Tsubame, Oboro aurait quelque chose d'important à vous montrer. Allez le retrouver dans l'entrepôt.
entries.ja: オボロが冒険者のことを待っているらしい。船着場の平屋の中にいる「オボロ」と話そう。

entries.en: After proudly displaying his own mastery of a challenging technique─the common Eorzean bow─Oboro teaches you your second mudra. Known as <italic(1)>Chi<italic(0)> in the Doman tongue, this gesture will allow you to call forth the power of the earth itself. When you are prepared to learn how to wield it in battle, speak with Oboro once more.
entries.macro: After proudly displaying his own mastery of a challenging technique─the common Eorzean bow─Oboro teaches you your second mudra. Known as <italic(1)>Chi<italic(0)> in the Doman tongue, this gesture will allow you to call forth the power of the earth itself. When you are prepared to learn how to wield it in battle, speak with Oboro once more.
entries.fr: Oboro vous a enseigné un nouveau signe mudrâ, “Chi”. Adressez-vous de nouveau à lui pour découvrir comment en tirer le meilleur parti au combat.
entries.ja: オボロから新たな印、「地の印」を教えてもらった。修行の説明を聞くため、再度オボロに話しかけよう。

entries.en: <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>! Why, I did not even hear your footsteps as you approached. You are becoming more and more the shinobi with each day.
entries.macro: <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>! Why, I did not even hear your footsteps as you approached. You are becoming more and more the shinobi with each day.

entries.ja:
おや、, ,1)>様。
ふふふ、忍びの者として、たくましくなられましたね！

entries.en: Oboro has been awaiting your return. Please, enter.
entries.fr: Il me semble qu'Oboro a quelque chose d'important à vous montrer. Il vous attend à l'intérieur de l'entrepôt, ne le faites pas patienter davantage<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
オボロ様が平屋でお待ちです。
どうぞ、お入りください。

entries.en: Hand before the torso, bend at the hips... Presence of mind, presence of mind...
entries.fr: Bien droit, le bras souple... Ça alors, je me demande bien pourquoi les Éorzéens ont adopté un salut si compliqué à exécuter<nbsp>!
entries.ja: 心を無にすれば……礼もうまくいくはず……。
entries.frMacro: Bien droit, le bras souple... Ça alors, je me demande bien pourquoi les Éorzéens ont adopté un salut si compliqué à exécuter<nbsp>!
entries.speaker: OBORO

entries.en: The ease with which you have grasped the basics of our art is impressive, to say the least. Neglect not your training, and I can foresee the day when your skills rival my own.
entries.fr: Vous progressez si rapidement dans la voie du ninja... Je sens que vous n'allez pas tarder à me surpasser<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ふふふ、たくましくなられましたね！
私なんて、すぐに抜かされてしまいそうです。

entries.en: Ah, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>. It is clear from the manner in which you carry yourself that you have been most diligent in your training.
entries.macro: Ah, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>. It is clear from the manner in which you carry yourself that you have been most diligent in your training.
entries.fr: Ah, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)><nbsp>! Vous me semblez... différent<if(gnum4,e,)>. Mais ne croyez pas que vous êtes <if(gnum4,la seule,le seul)> à avoir progressé<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
, ,1)>……腕を上げたようだな。
しかし、成長したのは、お主だけではござらぬぞ。

entries.en: But you are not the only one who has mastered the technique imparted to you. Behold my Eorzean bow, perfect in balance and form!
entries.fr: Que dites-vous de cette révérence<nbsp>? Le naturel même, n'est-ce pas<nbsp>? C'est le fruit de centaines d'heures d'en<->traî<->ne<->ment intensif<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
見よ、この自然な礼を……。
日々の鍛錬を積んだ成果だ。
……さて、今度は、我々が修行を課す番だな。

entries.en: ...Ahem. Now, it is time for your next lesson. Watch carefully my hands, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>. With this mudra, the shinobi can summon the energies of the earth─<italic(1)>Chi<italic(0)>, in our tongue. Etch its form in your mind, and I shall show you how to employ it in battle.

entries.fr: ... Bon, l'heure est venue de vous enseigner un nouveau signe de mains rituel. Voici la mudrâ “Chi”, qui vous permettra de canaliser l'énergie qui circule dans la terre. Mémorisez-la et dites-moi lorsque vous serez prêt<if(gnum4,e,)> à passer à la pratique.
entries.ja:
それでは、お主に新たな「印」……「地の印」を教える。
これは、大地に満ちるエーテルを結ぶ「印」だ。
後ほど、実戦を交えた修行を行うとしよう。
